extracted.name: Speedy Chili Pot Pie
extracted.description: Even kids can make this easy chili pot pie topped with cornbread. All you do is pour, mix, and bake.
ingredient_lines: 1 (8.5 ounce) package cornbread mix (such as Jiffy®)
2 (15 ounce) cans turkey chili with beans, undrained
2 tablespoons shredded Cheddar cheese, or as desired
1 tablespoon sour cream, or to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F (200 degrees C).
Whisk together cornbread mix, milk, and egg in a bowl until slightly lumpy.
Pour turkey chili with beans into a 9-inch pie dish. Spoon cornbread batter over top.
Bake in the preheated oven until cornbread edges begin to brown and the center is set, 20 to 25 minutes.
Top each serving with Cheddar cheese and sour cream.
